verdict.rationale: pnpm's own docs name its lockfile `pnpm-lock.yaml`, a YAML text file that an agent could plausibly read and diff, and describe one lockfile shared across a workspace. The pack contains no documentation of the lockfile's schema or format, and no evidence of diffing it. missing for 10: a documented lockfile format/schema specification, explicit evidence of diffability or merge-friendliness, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents reading or diffing it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at a documented, text-based lockfile format it can read and diff

citations.quote: The directory in which `pnpm-lock.yaml` is created. Several projects can share one lockfile.
